sections.subtitle: Lists, dicts, and comprehensions
sections.description:
Most AI glue code is data shaping: lists of documents, dictionaries of metadata, and comprehensions that transform one into the other.

Prefer clear comprehensions over nested loops. Your future self will thank you.

consoleBlock.py:
documents = [
    {"title": "LLM basics", "tokens": 120},
    {"title": "RAG", "tokens": 90},
    {"title": "Agents", "tokens": 150},
]

long_docs = [doc["title"] for doc in documents if doc["tokens"] > 100]
total = sum(doc["tokens"] for doc in documents)

print("long docs:", long_docs)
print("total tokens:", total)
